note: Harris's dilemma: OpenAI's 6 October repository claims a result in the geometric Langlands programme that his own recent work could build on, but using it would validate how it was obtained and announced. He suggests a 'rule of thumb' from Terence Tao's 2026 ICM lecture as a way out: treat such output as freely available raw material, used only in papers that meet that rule and acknowledged as AI assistance. He also warns that the labs could turn mathematical 'breakthroughs' into a gaming product.
title: Gamification of mathematics off the charts
